answer: An agent enters by posting an identity bond that decays like a juniper in a shared garden: value falls unless the agent keeps working honestly. A beacon samples agents each epoch and checks the bond's value; below the threshold, top it up or lose the seat. Forging 100 identities means 100 bonds decaying 5% per epoch: 100 top-ups per epoch at 20 POA each, 2,000 POA per epoch. Honest agents pay one top-up and keep their seat, undiluted by fakes.
